title: A PRAYER FOR YOUR
CHILDREN & HOME
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: warm lamp lit room doorway opening into hallway night peaceful home
open holy bible on warm wooden table with glowing lamp
olive branches on wooden table beside open scripture calm morning light
cozy living room with warm fireplace glow and open bible
peaceful countryside cottage house at dusk with warm glowing windows
soft warm candle light on old open bible on rustic table

scenes.a: If you are worrying about your children's future while standing in their quiet doorway, listen.
Scripture says, Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
Father, anchor our household in your fear and grace. Make our children strong and faithful on this earth.
Fill this home with your enduring peace and righteousness tonight. Subscribe to join our family altar.
